guide_detail: Aims welcomes Letters; Letter absent from article-type limit table. Short Communications allow two combined tables/figures. Historical 2017 no-figure language not treated as current.
decision: Restore one exact previously accepted main figure in author-review revision; editor may specify final placement
selection_reason: Morphological/diagnostic relevance; three groups fixed in original protocol. No per-histology rationale or formal closest-mimic ranking documented.
agency: Selected within this AI-assisted reanalysis, not by source dataset investigators or an independent pathology panel. Does not assert personal selection of each histology by author.
old_sentence: Higher RNA expression than in three investigator-selected comparators—myxoid liposarcoma, low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma (LGFMS) and synovial sarcoma—motivated examination of its position within a broader sarcoma reference.
new_sentence: For the initial reanalysis, myxoid liposarcoma, low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma (LGFMS) and synovial sarcoma were chosen as morphologically and diagnostically relevant comparisons with EMC. Higher CSPG4 RNA expression in EMC than in these groups motivated examination of its position within a broader sarcoma reference.
